newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy not planning to revalue gold stock -cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Italy not planning to revalue gold stock -cabinet.

text.p: The Italian government is not planning to revalue the country's gold reserves, cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli told reporters on Friday.
He was commenting on news that Germany was planning to revalue the Bundesbank gold reserves from current low book prices to levels close to the normal market value.
"It is not our intention (to revalue)" Micheli said at the end of a cabinet meeting.

A source at the Bank of Italy said earlier that Italian gold reserves were already priced at close to market values, in line with a formula approved by the European Monetary Institute (EMI). -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
